exploration.notes: Review could not begin because the managed sandbox rejected every attempted read-only shell process. Attempts comprised one smart-explore SKILL.md read and two HEAD checks using PowerShell and cmd.exe. A non-shell MCP resource inventory exposed no repository filesystem resource. No files were modified.

dimensions.name: architecture
dimensions.reason: The repository could not be accessed through the available environment, so module boundaries, dependency direction, and composition could not be inspected.

dimensions.name: solid
dimensions.reason: Production source files were inaccessible, preventing evidence-led evaluation of SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, or DIP.

dimensions.name: system_api_dependency
dimensions.reason: The environment blocked repository inspection, so Android, AAOS, vendor-system, permission, and failure-handling dependencies could not be located or assessed.

dimensions.name: hidden_api_reflection
dimensions.reason: Repository-wide searches and source reads were unavailable, so the presence and containment of hidden APIs or reflection could not be established.

dimensions.name: aidl_sdk_call
dimensions.reason: AIDL contracts and Binder or cross-process SDK call sites could not be inventoried because repository access was blocked.

dimensions.name: compilation_independence
dimensions.reason: Build entry points and declared dependencies could not be read; therefore no credible standalone build boundary could be established.

dimensions.name: integration_testing
dimensions.reason: Test files and fixtures were inaccessible, preventing assessment of behavioral depth across module, process, or platform boundaries.

dimensions.name: code_duplication
dimensions.reason: Production sources could not be inventoried or compared, so repeated handwritten logic and generated-code distinctions could not be evaluated.

dimensions.name: release_branch_strategy
dimensions.reason: Git commands were rejected by the sandbox, preventing ref inventory, history inspection, and the required bounded branch comparisons.

dimensions.name: platform_reuse
dimensions.reason: Platform or model implementations and branch differences could not be inspected, so common-core reuse and policy isolation could not be evaluated.

narrative: The required initial HEAD verification could not be performed: both read-only Git attempts were rejected before execution, so the supplied expected SHA could not be confirmed. Consequently, no repository-backed strengths or risks can be stated without fabrication, and all dimensions fail for environmental unavailability rather than observed code quality. The nominal 28-call budget was sufficient, but unusable because access failed after three shell attempts; the required production-file, test-file, AIDL, dependency, duplication, and branch exploration reached zero coverage. The smart-explore skill was selected for structural inspection but its instruction file was likewise blocked. No network access was used and no files were modified.
